IVX HOLDINGS — FULL 126-MODULE OPERATING MAP, 24/7 AI WORKFORCE SCHEDULE, CALENDAR, AND 2-HOUR OWNER REPORTING

OWNER DIRECTIVE: EXECUTE NOW

OBJECTIVE

Create one complete live operating map of the IVX application, landing page, backend, database, AI workforce, autonomous task schedule, deployments, and owner reporting.

I need to see clearly:

1. Every module operating in the app and landing page.
2. Whether each module is complete from 1–10.
3. What remains unfinished.
4. Which AI team owns each module.
5. What each AI is working on now.
6. What each AI completed today.
7. What each AI will work on next.
8. The autonomous schedule running 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
9. All scheduled work visible in a calendar.
10. A text message to the owner every 2 hours with the current execution report.

Do not return only a narrative report.
Build the dashboard, calendar, reporting pipeline, and verification evidence.

============================================================
PART 1 — DISCOVER THE REAL MODULE COUNT
============================================================

Inspect the entire production repository, Expo application, web application, landing page, backend, API routes, database, navigation, dashboards, and AI systems.

Determine the exact real module count.

If the count is:

- 100 modules, map MODULE-001 through MODULE-100.
- 126 modules, map MODULE-001 through MODULE-126.
- More than 126 modules, include all discovered production modules.

Do not invent modules.
Do not omit hidden, owner-only, admin, backend, landing, finance, AI, or infrastructure modules.

For each module return:

- Module number
- Module name
- Category
- App route
- Web route
- API endpoint
- Database tables
- Storage bucket
- Source files
- Owner AI team
- Current status
- Completion score from 0–10
- QA score from 0–10
- Security score from 0–10
- Production status
- Last verified timestamp
- Current defect IDs
- Work remaining
- Estimated completion time
- Proof Ledger ID

============================================================
PART 2 — REQUIRED MODULE CATEGORIES
============================================================

At minimum, map all real modules in these categories:

A. PUBLIC LANDING PAGE

- Homepage
- Hero section
- Investment cards
- Property media
- Reels section
- Registration
- Waitlist
- Lead capture
- Investor registration
- Buyer registration
- JV registration
- Tokenized-investor registration
- Landing analytics
- UTM tracking
- Public deal pages
- Public media
- Contact forms
- Public chat
- Mobile landing layout
- Desktop landing layout
- SEO
- Performance
- Accessibility

B. AUTHENTICATION AND OWNER CONTROL

- Owner login
- Logout
- Session persistence
- Password recovery
- Role authorization
- Protected routes
- Admin Hub
- Owner Dashboard
- Owner Controls
- Variables
- Settings
- Emergency stop
- Deployment approval
- Audit history

C. CRM AND PEOPLE

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Sellers
- Realtors
- Brokers
- Influencers
- Lenders
- JV partners
- Team members
- Lead scoring
- Lead assignment
- Outreach
- Follow-up
- Communication history
- Pipeline stages

D. DEALS AND REAL ESTATE

- Properties
- Deals
- Investment cards
- Deal Room
- Documents
- Due diligence
- Project media
- Construction updates
- Deal matching
- Capital targets
- Soft commitments
- Signed commitments
- Funding status
- Portfolio assignment

E. MEDIA AND SOCIAL

- Posts
- Images

- Videos
- Reels
- Upload
- Download
- Save
- Share
- Like
- Comments
- View counts
- Notifications
- Media processing
- Compression

- Cache
- Playback recovery
- Content moderation

F. CHAT AND AI

- Member chat
- Owner AI chat
- Senior Developer executor
- Live Work
- Task queue
- Task states
- Approval workflow
- Proof Ledger
- Evidence Collector
- Provider gateway
- Retry
- Failover
- 503 recovery
- Timeout recovery
- Conversation persistence
- Attachments
- Search
- Voice input

G. MONEY AND INVESTMENTS

- Investor pipeline
- KYC
- AML
- Accreditation
- Deal subscription
- Electronic signature
- Wire instructions
- ACH readiness
- Escrow tracking
- Funds received
- Transaction ledger
- Wallets
- Statements

- Distributions
- Fees
- Commissions

- Realtor payments
- Revenue
- Reconciliation
- Audit trail

H. INFRASTRUCTURE

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- AWS
- Storage
- Backups
- Migrations
- Health endpoints
- Monitoring
- Alerts
- Queue
- Background workers
- Rollback
- APK
- AAB
- iOS readiness
- Web production
- CI/CD
- Security
- Performance
- Stress testing

============================================================
PART 3 — COMPLETION SCORE DEFINITION
============================================================

Use this exact scale:

0/10 — Not created
1/10 — Placeholder only
2/10 — UI exists, no real backend
3/10 — Partial frontend/backend
4/10 — Basic workflow incomplete
5/10 — Main workflow works with major defects
6/10 — Mostly functional, incomplete QA
7/10 — Functional with moderate issues
8/10 — Production-capable with minor issues
9/10 — Fully tested and deployed
10/10 — Live, stable, secure, regression-tested, device-tested, monitored, and proof-verified

A module may receive 10/10 only with:

- working frontend
- working backend
- real database connection
- correct permissions
- automated tests
- live deployment
- live production verification
- no critical defect
- Proof Ledger evidence

Do not assign 10/10 based on UI or narrative alone.

============================================================
PART 4 — LIVE OWNER MODULE DASHBOARD
============================================================

Build one live dashboard named:

IVX MODULE COMMAND CENTER

It must show:

- Total modules
- Modules 10/10
- Modules 8–9/10
- Modules 5–7/10
- Modules below 5/10
- Failed modules
- Blocked modules
- Modules currently being repaired
- Current assigned AI team
- Current task
- Current task duration
- Current branch
- Current commit
- Current deployment
- Last QA result
- Next action
- Estimated completion date

Required filters:

- Landing
- Mobile
- Web
- Backend
- Database
- Media
- Investors
- Money
- AI
- Security
- Infrastructure
- Complete
- In progress
- Failed
- Blocked
- Not started

Every module row must open a detailed evidence page.

============================================================
PART 5 — MAP ALL AI TEAMS
============================================================

Map every active AI agent and team.

For each AI return:

- AI ID
- AI name
- Team
- Role
- Current status
- Current task ID
- Assigned module
- Task start time
- Expected finish time
- Last completed task
- Git commit
- Deployment ID
- Current blocker
- Next queued task
- Allowed tools
- Deployment permission
- Daily work total
- Seven-day performance
- Verification status

Map at least these teams if they truly exist:

TEAM-01 Architecture
TEAM-02 Frontend
TEAM-03 Backend
TEAM-04 Database
TEAM-05 Media
TEAM-06 QA
TEAM-07 Security
TEAM-08 Performance
TEAM-09 DevOps
TEAM-10 Monitoring
TEAM-11 Business
TEAM-12 Release Manager

Do not count an AI as active merely because a database row exists.

Statuses must be:

- RUNNING
- QUEUED
- WAITING_APPROVAL
- RETRYING
- BLOCKED
- FAILED
- VERIFIED
- OFFLINE
- UNTESTED

============================================================
PART 6 — 24/7 AUTONOMOUS WORK SCHEDULE
============================================================

Create a real 24-hour operating schedule.

The AI workforce must work continuously using rotating queues.

SCHEDULE A — CONTINUOUS MONITORING

Runs every hour:

- API health
- Owner AI health
- Database health
- Queue health
- Provider health
- Render health
- Authentication health
- 503 detection
- Timeout detection
- Failed-task detection
- Security alerts
- Backup status

SCHEDULE B — ENGINEERING EXECUTION

Runs continuously:

- Pick highest-priority defect
- Reproduce
- Diagnose
- Fix
- Test
- Build
- Request approval
- Deploy
- Verify
- Record proof
- Continue to next task

SCHEDULE C — QA MATRIX

Runs on rotation:

00:00–04:00 — Backend/API/database QA
04:00–08:00 — Mobile and owner authentication QA
08:00–12:00 — Landing page, media, reels, posts
12:00–16:00 — Investors, buyers, CRM, deals
16:00–20:00 — Money, transactions, KYC, documents
20:00–24:00 — Regression, security, performance, deployment

This rotation repeats every day.

SCHEDULE D — RELEASE WINDOW

Only TEAM-12 Release Manager may deploy.

Production deployment occurs only when:

- tests pass
- owner approval exists
- rollback tag exists
- database backup exists
- no active deployment exists
- health verification is ready

============================================================
PART 7 — AUTONOMOUS CALENDAR
============================================================

Create a calendar named:

IVX 24/7 AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING CALENDAR

Every scheduled task must appear on the calendar with:

- Task title
- Task ID
- Assigned AI
- Module
- Priority
- Start time
- Expected end time
- Current status
- Approval required
- Deployment window
- Proof Ledger link

Calendar views required:

- Today
- 24 hours
- Week
- By AI team
- By module
- By priority
- Deployments
- Owner approvals
- Blockers
- Completed work

Calendar entries must update automatically when:

- task starts
- task pauses
- task retries
- task is reassigned
- owner approval is required
- deployment begins
- deployment ends
- task is verified

Do not create a static calendar screenshot.
Create a live production calendar.

============================================================
PART 8 — TEXT MESSAGE EVERY 2 HOURS
============================================================

Create a 2-hour owner executive SMS report.

OWNER PHONE:

561-644-3503

Before sending any SMS:

1. Verify an approved SMS provider is configured.
2. Verify the phone number is owner-authorized.
3. Store the number securely.
4. Do not expose it publicly or in logs.
5. Send only operational summaries.
6. Do not include passwords, tokens, private investor documents, or secrets.

Schedule:

Every 2 hours, 24 hours per day.

Each SMS must contain:

IVX 2-HOUR REPORT

- Production: HEALTHY / DEGRADED / FAILED
- Modules complete: X / total
- Modules in progress: X
- Tasks completed: X
- Tasks running: X
- Tasks blocked: X
- Current top task
- Last Git commit
- Last Render deployment
- Owner approval required: YES / NO
- Critical incident: YES / NO
- Dashboard link

If no approved SMS provider is configured, return:

BLOCKED — SMS PROVIDER CONFIGURATION REQUIRED

Do not claim SMS reporting works until a real test message is delivered and receipt is confirmed.

Also publish the full two-hour report inside:

- IVX Owner AI chat
- Owner Dashboard
- Engineering Calendar
- Proof Ledger

============================================================
PART 9 — OWNER APPROVAL ALERTS
============================================================

Send immediate owner alerts for:

- Production deployment approval
- Emergency stop activation
- Critical 500/503 incident
- Owner login failure
- Database incident
- Provider outage
- Payment or transaction incident
- Security violation
- Rollback required
- Task blocked longer than 2 hours

Each alert must include:

- Task/incident ID
- Exact issue
- Risk
- Required owner action
- One approval phrase
- Expiration time

============================================================
PART 10 — LIVE WORK PANEL
============================================================

The Live Work panel must show actual execution, not only status text.

Show:

- AI currently working
- Task ID
- Module
- File currently inspected
- File changed
- Command running
- Test running
- Elapsed time
- Last checkpoint
- Next checkpoint
- Retry count
- Current branch
- Current commit
- Deployment status
- Cancel
- Pause
- Approve
- Open evidence

No fake progress percentages.

============================================================
PART 11 — QA EVERY MODULE
============================================================

For each discovered module:

1. Verify route opens.
2. Verify permissions.
3. Verify real data loads.
4. Verify create.
5. Verify read.
6. Verify update.
7. Verify delete where authorized.
8. Verify error handling.
9. Verify empty state.
10. Verify loading state.
11. Verify Android.
12. Verify web.
13. Verify database.
14. Verify API.
15. Verify security.
16. Verify performance.
17. Verify regression.
18. Verify monitoring.
19. Verify production.
20. Record evidence.

Every module must have a final completion score.

============================================================
PART 12 — FIX AND DEPLOY
============================================================

For every failed or incomplete module:

- Create defect ID
- Assign AI team
- Identify root cause
- Fix code
- Run typecheck
- Run unit tests
- Run integration tests
- Run E2E tests
- Build
- Request owner approval if required
- Deploy through TEAM-12
- Verify production
- Retest module
- Update module score
- Write Proof Ledger

Continue automatically until all agent-executable tasks are complete.

============================================================
PART 13 — REQUIRED PRODUCTION EVIDENCE
============================================================

Return:

- Exact module count
- Complete module registry
- Module scores
- AI workforce registry
- Current AI assignments
- 24/7 schedule
- Calendar URL
- Two-hour report schedule
- SMS test result
- GitHub repository
- Branch
- Commit SHA
- Render service ID
- Render Deployment ID
- Health endpoint results
- Open incidents
- Remaining blockers
- Owner approvals required
- Proof Ledger IDs

============================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
============================================================

Do not claim COMPLETE until:

- Every real module is discovered.
- Every module has a 0–10 score.
- Every incomplete item has a task and assigned AI.
- Every AI has a real schedule and task queue.
- The autonomous calendar is live.
- Two-hour reports are generated automatically.
- SMS delivery is tested successfully or honestly marked blocked.
- The Owner Dashboard shows real-time work.
- Production health is verified.
- GitHub/Render/runtime SHA parity is verified.
- No fake metrics or fake progress exists.

FINAL STATUS MUST BE EXACTLY ONE:

VERIFIED
FAILED
or BLOCKED

Begin by returning:

1. Exact module count
2. Current 0–10 completion distribution
3. AI team status table
4. Current 24-hour schedule
5. Calendar implementation status
6. SMS implementation status
7. First two-hour report time
8. Current blockers
9. Owner approvals required
10. Execution start timestamp
